extractedWith: tools/extract/extract.ps1 -Batch p5-settings -Manifest <scratch copy of allowlist.manifest.yaml plus the p5-settings batch> -Clean (staging %TEMP%/codelab-extract/p5-settings, outside the repo; scrub findings are expected before the rewrite)
promotion: Each staged file was read as a reference and rewritten with starter names and structure; "target" is the repo file it informed, "stagedTarget" the path in the staging folder. Content is a rewrite, so the repo file hash differs from stagedSha256. Source-product settings were dropped; only the patterns were carried.

origins.note: Rewritten as the UpdateSetting use case over ISettingsRepository and ISettingsUnitOfWork: the bounded-value validation (now per SettingValueType and per-setting MinValue/MaxValue in Domain/SettingValueFormat) and the UpdatedAt/UpdatedBy audit columns are carried; the in-process static refresh, which updated one node only, is replaced by a stamp version written in the same transaction and a 30 s TimeProvider-driven snapshot TTL (Application/Reading). The single source-product setting was not carried.

Pattern only: the service port became the module ports (ISettingsRepository, ISettingsUnitOfWork, ISettingsSnapshotSource) and the kernel IRuntimeSettings read port; the result-wrapper enum became Outcome/Refusal.

Rewritten as the generic SettingResponse (key, group, valueType as int, value, defaultValue, ar/en descriptions, updatedAt) and UpdateSettingRequest {value}; the source-product field and the updated-by user id on the wire were not carried.

Rewritten as a thin controller over ListSettings and UpdateSetting with SettingsPermissionKeys (settings.view, settings.manage), keyed by setting key instead of a single-row document, mapping problem+json through OutcomeResults. The per-setting POST route and the anonymous-object error bodies were not carried.
Rewritten as the settings.Settings (key-value rows) and settings.SettingsStamp (single row) configurations; the single-row typed configuration table was not carried.
Pattern only: the bounds-validation and audit-column tests were rewritten for the generic settings with FakeTimeProvider and fakes; the source-product window tests were not carried.

Read for settings consumed by jobs: the only one was a source-product duration held in a static. It informed the MODULE.md guidance to read IRuntimeSettings on every use (never keep a value in a static) and the forbidden rule settings.no-static-setting-state; no job content was carried.
